name: Letterboxx
summary: Mac app that turns email newsletters into a local reading library with collections, highlights and a cleaner reading view.
description: Letterboxx connects to Gmail, iCloud Mail, Outlook, DreamHost or any IMAP account, imports newsletter copies from the mail folders you pick, and gives them a local reading library: Letterboxxes collections, Auto-Delivery rules that sort senders automatically, Clean View for cluttered newsletter HTML, highlights, reminders and encrypted backups. It is a dedicated newsletter reader for macOS, not an email client — originals stay in the mailbox. 14-day free trial.
contains: imports newsletter copies from Gmail, iCloud Mail, Outlook, DreamHost or any standard IMAP account
Letterboxxes collections, Smart Filters and Auto-Delivery routing rules
Clean View trims trackers, ads, embeds and messy email HTML
highlights, reading reminders, dashboard and message diagnostics
encrypted local backups of newsletters, rules, highlights and settings
reader themes: light, dark, e-ink, newspaper and more
14-day free trial; Mac App Store app
